§4.6 Recurring Page Furniture

📚 Document rule — needs other pages of the document; decided once and applied on every page

layout-recurring-page-furniture · rule layout

✅ Normative

Whether a margin band is page furniture MUST be decided once for the document. A band that is page furniture on one page MUST be page furniture — a Page-header or Page-footer, never body text and never a heading — on every page it appears on.

The repeated strip at the top or bottom margin: an agency name, a running title, a brand mark, a document or exhibit stamp, a revision date, a folio. It carries no argument; it tells the reader which document the sheet belongs to.

DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES        PRINTED: 03/18/2021   ← header band
CENTERS FOR MEDICARE & MEDICAID SERVICES       OMB NO. 0938-0391

… the page's actual content …

FORM CMS-2567  Previous Versions Obsolete            Page 3 of 12    ← footer band

Decided from the document

The same string is easy to read as a title on the page where it is largest or first, and as furniture everywhere else. The decision MUST be made from several pages: a string that recurs in the same margin with the same wording is furniture on all of them, including the first.

A cover page is the one place a repeated string MAY also be the document title. The cover occurrence is then the Title and every later occurrence is furniture; the cover MUST NOT decide the rest of the document. Which sheet is the cover is decided in Document Type§4.4.

A single page

Where only one page is available, a band in the top or bottom margin that carries no argument of its own — a running title, an agency name, a folio — is furniture. Where the only reason to call it furniture would be that it repeats on pages that are not available, it MUST be kept where the page prints it, in its printed position.

Never a heading

A running header MUST NOT be rendered as a heading. Promoted, it corrupts the outline twice over: it invents a section that does not exist, and it repeats that invented section on every page. A document whose outline is its own masthead repeated forty times has no usable structure left. This is the never invent failure — the page prints a margin band, not a section.

A heading that repeats on more than half the pages of a document is almost always furniture filed as structure.

Bands that contain a graphic

A band MUST be kept together, graphic included; the mark MUST NOT escape into the body flow. What the graphic itself becomes is decided by Images§12.1.1 and Logos§12.1.3.

Bands that change partway through

Long documents revise their furniture — a new date, a new form number, a different layout after a section break. A change of wording does not make the band content. The same disposition MUST apply before and after the change, and each variant MUST be transcribed as it is printed.
